instruction: Search through Obsidian for every note containing "harbor-ticket", then write the absolute paths of all matching notes to "$HOME/Desktop/obsidian_search_3.txt", listing one per line.

command:
content=$(printf '%b' '# Harbor Follow-up

Need one clean harbor-ticket example for testing.
'); obsidian-cli create "Meetings/Harbor Follow-up.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

content=$(printf '%b' '# Harbor Backlog

Keep the harbor-ticket issue separate from UI cleanup.
'); obsidian-cli create "Projects/Harbor Backlog.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

content=$(printf '%b' '# Health Check

Book a routine appointment next month.
'); obsidian-cli create "Areas/Health Check.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

reference_command:
python3 - <<'PY' > "$HOME/Desktop/obsidian_search_3.txt"
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
vault = Path(r'''/Users/pipiwu/Documents/Benchmark/Benchmark''')
query = r'''harbor-ticket'''
for path in sorted(vault.rglob('*.md')):
    rel = str(path.relative_to(vault))
    out = subprocess.run(['obsidian-cli', 'print', rel, '--vault', 'Benchmark'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if out.returncode == 0 and query in out.stdout:
        print(path)
PY
